content.text: {"core": "Abstraction pulls particulars up into patterns that can travel. In Wisdom, it works on what is quietly held — deep knowing that waits without explaining itself. Underdone, that knowing never lifts: it stays felt but shapeless, present but untransmittable. The pattern that could have moved stays locked where no one else can reach it.", "sheetLine": "The knowing sits there, real but wordless, and nothing carries it forward."}
